# Navigation menu

Site navigation with links and panels.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-navigation-menu--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:light" title="Navigation menu examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-navigation-menu--docs">Open Navigation menu in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-navigation-menu--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** The site sections.

- **Use it when:** The main sections of a website, sometimes with a panel of sub-links.
- **Not when:** App navigation that stays open (sidebar), or actions (dropdown menu).

Instead:

- [Sidebar](./sidebar.md): App navigation that stays open.
- [Tabs](./tabs.md): Views of one thing.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a navigation landmark; the current page is marked. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add navigation-menu
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Navigation menu reads 47 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Navigation menu's tokens to change Navigation menu alone.
